show.title: Soulection Radio Show #139 w/ DJ Harrison
show.content:
DJ Harrison thows down a crazy live improvised session with the SP-404 and MPC1000

<!--more-->

oe Kay started off with some nice deep/melodic tracks from Mr. Carmack, Christoph El Truento, Dirg Gerner, Iamnobodi, Sango, Last Night In Paris, Geode and many more! Joe took it back to the essence with Ginuwine/Timbaland/Dilla classics! DJ Harrison on the other hand who reminds us of Madlib (no really he does)all the way from Virginia threw down a crazy live session with the SP-404 & MPC 1000. Lots of soulful chops and intricate drum patterns! This is another amazing session from start to finish! Spread this if you feel it.

Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.

show.title: Soulection Radio Show #140 w/ Esta & Andres
show.content:
ESTA and Andres stop on by and deliver solid sets.

<!--more-->

Had to start this show with a new unreleased gem from Kaytra and play all the classics/unreleased material as usual. Esta finally stopped by to drop an official set and talk about what's next for him. He really impressed us with his house vibes. This man is diverse. Andres also came through and graced us with a heavy hitter set. Spread this if you feel it.

Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.

show.title: Soulection Radio Show #143
show.content:
Joe Kay focuses playing dropping just over 100 tracks in 3 hours 

<!--more-->

It's been about 3 months or more since there has been no guest on Soulection Radio. 
It's been an amazing journey of having so many different personalities roll through the station and educate us with their production, selections, knowledge, and experiences. 
This week Joe Kay wanted to let loose and focus strictly on his selection. Within 3 hours Joe dropped just over 100 tracks, that's right over 100! 


Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.
